description.subtitle: Ghana 2026 Pre-Party Warming T-Shirt Selection Puma - Red
description.tagline: Activa tu juego desde el calentamiento
description.intro: The Puma Ghana 2026 Pre-Match T-shirt is designed for the moments before the match, when the preparation begins and the intensity rises. Inspired by the one used by players during the warm-up, it combines lightness, breathability and style.
key_benefits: Official pre-match design: Used by players during heating.
Lightweight fabric: Promotes mobility and comfort.
Alta transpirabilidad: Mantiene el cuerpo fresco durante el esfuerzo.
Fast drying: Evacuate sweat for comfort.
Estilo deportivo: Perfecta para entrenar o uso diario.
